changes.reason: Check stored outbox ownership and lease immediately before starting publication; release expired unstarted claims using the existing attempt fence.

kubernetes.reason: The Node Host does not participate in the relay claim check. This coordination logic uses the existing store read and attempt-fenced release without adding host capabilities, storage formats or lifecycle boundaries.
constraints: The configured store must expose current claim state. A lease may be lost after the check or during an active callback; delivery remains at-least-once and requires external idempotency. No infrastructure support or certification claim is added.
